description: Search the public fragment/essay index by topic and return ranked matching fragment IDs, summaries and links. Use this for essay discovery, not the mapped event-record catalog (search_public_story_records) or one record's full text (get_public_story_record). No authentication required; zero matches means no indexed match.

max_results.description: Optional result count from 1 to 10; defaults to 5.

query.description: Required public-fragment search text, 1–1000 characters; use topic/interest words, not a guessed fragment ID.

name: search_cassie_hour_fragments
title: Search Cassie Hour fragments
